summary: Captured per-request TTFT and TPOT (excl. TTFT) via streaming /generate. TTFT ~80ms across all probes (Qwen3-8B prefill on short prompts). TPOT 104-135 ms/tok (= 7.4-9.6 tok/s), dominated by per-position multi-decode (dtn=2 → 2 decode_forward per verify cycle); inversely tracks spec_accept_rate.
config: --speculative-num-steps 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 2 (v94 optimal); EAGLE-3 target Qwen3-8B on 2x P150a + Tengyunw/qwen3_8b_eagle3 draft on CPU torch
probe_method: Streaming /generate with temperature=0.0; TTFT = wall-clock from request send to first SSE chunk; TPOT = (e2e_latency - TTFT) / (completion_tokens - 1)

results.prompt: Tell me about Python programming language

prometheus_aggregate.note: Aggregate spec_accept_rate=0.2 matches v94 numbers; gen_throughput is requests/sec across the 3 probes (~1 req per 6.5 s on average given run intermixed with warmup).

interpretation.ttft_floor_breakdown: Prefill for 5-6 prompt tokens at Qwen3-8B BF16 on 2x P150a (paged path, trace-mode prefill). Stable across probes because prompt is short and prefill bucket is the small one.
interpretation.tpot_breakdown: Each verify cycle = 2 decode_forward calls (dtn=2, multi-decode). Per-cycle wall-time ~150-170ms. Tokens per cycle = spec_accept_length (1.2-1.6). TPOT = per_cycle_ms / accept_length.
interpretation.speedup_path: Trace-mode aux-hidden persistence (analog of process_hidden_states_after_prefill_trace) could collapse the 2x decode_forward back to 1, halving TPOT toward ~50-65 ms/tok (15-20 tok/s). Out of session scope.
